name: Airport-parting-scene
scenePrompt: An overwhelming parting dialogue of a father and daughter. Daughter has to go abroad for studies. Father is too worried because it her first time being detached from family and is too young

speakers.actingPrompt: Soft-spoken, warm, slightly nervous, voice is filled with emotions
Very bubbly, excited but at the same time too overwhelmed emotionally because loves her family very much

lines.speaker: Female1
lines.text: Papa! Can you believe it? My flight to Paris!

lines.speaker: Female1
lines.text: It's really happening! I'm so excited!

lines.speaker: Male1
lines.text: Yes, my little explorer. It's... wonderful.

lines.speaker: Male1
lines.text: Just remember to call, okay? Every day.

lines.speaker: Female1
lines.text: Of course! Twice a day if you want! You worry too much.

lines.speaker: Male1
lines.text: You're so young, darling. This is your first time away.

lines.speaker: Female1
lines.text: I'll be fine, Papa. I'm a big girl now, almost!

lines.speaker: Male1
lines.text: I know. But stay warm. Eat properly. No shortcuts.

lines.speaker: Female1
lines.text: I promise. And I'll study so hard, you'll be proud.

lines.speaker: Male1
lines.text: I'm already proud, my love. So very proud.

lines.speaker: Male1
lines.text: Just... be careful out there, alright?

lines.speaker: Female1
lines.text: I'm going to miss you all so much. My heart feels heavy.

lines.speaker: Male1
lines.text: We'll miss you more, sweet pea. More than words.

lines.speaker: Male1
lines.text: Just go. Live your dream. We'll be waiting.
